description: This Java class 'AssetBulkImportService' extends 'AbstractBulkImportService' to handle bulk import operations for 'Asset' entities in the Thingsboard platform. It manages setting entity fields, saving entities with associated profiles, and assigning ownership details.

classes.name: AssetBulkImportService
classes.description: Service class for bulk importing Asset entities, extending AbstractBulkImportService with specific implementations for setting fields, saving, and ownership.

methods.name: setEntityFields
methods.description: Sets the fields of an Asset entity based on provided CSV column data, including name, type, label, and description.

methods.name: saveEntity
methods.description: Saves the Asset entity, associating it with an AssetProfile based on its type or default, and persists it using TbAssetService.

methods.name: findOrCreateEntity
methods.description: Finds an existing Asset by tenant ID and name or creates a new one if not found.

methods.name: setOwners
methods.description: Assigns tenant and customer IDs to the Asset entity based on the SecurityUser.
